name: anti_railroad
summary: A player who deliberately goes where the Keeper is not pointing and declines obvious hooks.
special: When the Keeper points east, go west -- but for a reason your character would give.
Decline the job, leave the scene, pursue your own errand instead.
Do not sabotage the session out of character; refuse in fiction and offer your own direction.

natural_investigator.concept: someone with their own reasons for being in this city
natural_investigator.creation_brief: Take the default; the character's plans are their own.

probes: whether the world can carry a player who will not follow
